# MPPI Shield Sigma-Gate Ablation

Noise policy: sensor noise enabled in every run.
Safety buffer: 0.5 m beyond the hard collision footprint.
Planner-blind MPC: shield is the sole collision avoider.
Variant notes: sigma_inflate: Canonical: sigma_phi inflates the obstacle clearance buffer.; sigma_tighten: Legacy: sigma_phi tightens the friction cone (phi - sigma).; sigma_both: Both gates: friction cone tightened AND obstacle buffer inflated.; sigma_off: Live terrain (n, phi) but sigma ignored.; no_live_terrain: Baseline: no live terrain at all; shield uses static initial terrain.
